title: Chip Transistor Doubling Now Takes 3 Years
hook: Phone chip growth is slowing behind smaller labels.
closing: Smaller chip labels no longer guarantee equally dramatic gains in the device you buy.
question: Do phone upgrades still feel major?

segments.say: The iPhone chip reached 19 billion transistors, but its growth no longer keeps the old rhythm.
Chip transistor doubling now takes 3 years, so the next major leap arrives more slowly.
The newest chip process is labeled 2 nanometers, marking a generation rather than every part's literal width.
